text: Codex runs on gpt-6-astra at ultra, its highest reasoning, by @gitdek's call on 2026-10-29. -codex-model and -codex-effort default to them in watch, formalize and synthesize, so Codex no longer takes the shared -effort, which stays Claude Code's, at max, its highest. A Codex build the loop guard stops at ultra runs once more at -fallback-effort, xhigh, as D-0125 has a Claude Code build at max do. An effort Codex doesn't take is refused before anything runs.
